chunk_map.heading: The branch one of you found is often worth most

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6: "Merge everyone's opportunity trees and that branch looks like noise" closest; "that branch" resolves to "the branch one of you found" (L1 header, L4); "the ones" resolves to branches; "opportunity trees" is a named technique the audience holds from the same lecture, introduced as a noun phrase not a pronoun. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.
L4-8: no pointer to another file or position; "everyone's opportunity trees" names the artefact. Closest: none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "where someone heard a customer the others did not" is a generic scenario, not "the X you did/saw"; no event-in-room backreference.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess/predict cue, no demo reveal. Muted read of L4-8: every sentence is verbed ("Merge...", "Hand the merge...", "Keep the name..."); closest L6 "Hand the merge to an agent and it gets worse" has a verbed scene, referent "the merge" named in prior sentence.
L4-8: three paragraphs, each self-carrying; closest L8 "Treat a branch with one name as a question to answer" still carries a claim standalone.
Header L1 "The branch one of you found is often worth most" is borne out by L4 and L8 (the single-name branch is the question); no contradiction. Closest: "often" is hedged identically in body L4.

L8 "a question to answer, not a vote to lose" is a one-line contrast inside a declarative, not the banned "Not X. Not Y. Z." sentence run; no triplets (L4 pair "a customer ... a ticket" is two legs); no superlative self-grade ("worth the most" is a claim about branches, not about the training); no number; no abstraction stack. Closest: L8 contrast, inside the cap.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: greps clean: no dialect terms in L1-8 (banned_words/leverage/ritual 0). Closest: "opportunity trees" is practitioner vocabulary (Torres), not repo dialect.
